text: The cough has been bothering me for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started more recently. speaker: Doctor
text: I understand the cardiologist's assessment, but the presence of yellowish mucus and the duration of your cough raise concerns for a concurrent respiratory infection or pneumonia. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia complicating Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction. The chest X-ray confirms infection in the right lower lobe, which requires antibiotic therapy alongside your current heart failure management.
